chapter: Movies and the Los Angeles scene
title: Sitting in with Benny Carter in Los Angeles
summary: Stewart sat in on after-hours sessions with Benny Carter, who lived in L.A., while out there with Slim.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: That's good. Now, when you -- did you ever work with Benny Carter in those days?
I sat in on a couple of after hour sessions with him in L.A., yes.
Oh, you met him in Los Angeles?
What, during the time that you were making the movie?
During the time that I was out there with Slim.
Was Carter living out there at that time or was he just there on a tour?
I think he was living there, yes.
